label: sdc02_4kings_b_01_clerk_00
text: Welcome! Feel free to look around and get\nacquainted with our Elite Four team!

label: sdc02_4kings_b_01_clerk_01
text: Welcome to the Canyon Plaza! We’re the team\nthat supports Amarys of the Elite Four!

label: sdc02_4kings_b_01_clerk_03
text: You’ll need to hand over 50 BP if you want\nto take on the Elite Trial here.\c\nAre you ready and willing to pay?

label: sdc02_4kings_b_01_clerk_04
text: Oh. You don’t have enough BP, I’m afraid... You\ncan earn some by taking on BBQs, though!

label: sdc02_4kings_b_01_clerk_05
text: Thank you very much! Duly received and noted!

label: sdc02_4kings_b_01_clerk_06
text: Now here she comes—our very own Amarys!

label: sdc02_4kings_b_01_steelbb_02
text: As you see, I’m present and ready for your trial.[VAR 0x0114(0048)]

label: sdc02_4kings_b_01_steelbb_03
text: A change of location is required... Come.[VAR 0x0114(0048)]
